column1: # Game profile of Pokemon Brilliant Diamond 1.3.0 (Unity 2019.4.27f1 IL2CPP, SDK 11.4.3, NVN).
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file.
# Virtual address memory: nninitStartup gives pool - used to StandardAllocator, without setting a heap.
# The SDK node-area cut is in dm/tools/sdk_patches.py. A 2 GB pool leaves room beside StandardAllocator for Unity pools; see README.md.
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# Unity sets Application.targetFrameRate to 30 when entering the field. The build-gated engine limiter raises it; display pacing also ignores the game's interval 2.
# DM_FPS_TARGET=30 DM_PRESENT_INTERVAL=game restores the original rate.
# Reviewed Fl4sh water/snow, NPC movement and AI timing corrections.
# Timing correction assumes >=30 rendered FPS; discard missed whole water updates after stalls.
# PEANUTS begin: picture shapes, untested candidates (aspect_plan, dm/host/aspect_plan.h): Game settings > Display > Fill
# NOT SEEN ON A DEVICE. Every place the 1.3.0 pack's main has the packed 1920x1080 sizes in code and the 16/9 float words (a scan of the code on 2026-11-21, no community patch behind them):
# the 3D view may follow the screen, the 2D layer may not, or the game may draw wrongly or not start with Fill. Fit is unchanged. Take out the
# rows that prove wrong, and aspect_plan_untested once a device has shown the rest right (the note says what was seen).
